commands.help: Extract saved passwords and cookies from Firefox profiles.
commands.long_help: Extract Firefox secrets from accessible profiles. With no mode, extract passwords only; use --mode /all for passwords and cookies or --mode /cookies for cookies only. Requires a Sliver client, server, and implant with built-in BOF/Reflektor support. Use only on systems and data you are authorized to access.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Extraction mode: omit for passwords, set --mode /all for passwords and cookies, or --mode /cookies for cookies only.
